name: mcparrot
description: Connect websites to AI assistants through reusable MCP tools powered by Browser Use

paragraphs: MCParrot turns the website pages you explore into proposed tools your assistant can use. You browse once, choose suggested tasks, sign in once in a Browser Use cloud browser, and connect ChatGPT to run those tasks. One website app can contain many saved tasks. Canvas is a useful example, not a product limit.

This document is the single home for product behavior, architecture, and local setup. It describes the intended product and is written for coding agents. The status page records which parts are shipped, dormant, aspirational, or known gaps. Nathan reads matching HTML guides for the product flow, the LA Hacks 2026 hackathon, and working together. Follow the documentation rules when you change any document. See how agents work with Nathan and hackathon judging and prizes for those subjects.

requirements.text: You browse once, choose suggested tasks, sign in once in a Browser Use cloud browser, and connect ChatGPT to run those tasks.
Each connection also has a submitverificationcode tool, which finishes an automatic sign-in, as reconnecting expired sessions describes.
MCParrot keeps every trace and every session because it has one user, and it sends logs through the SDK instead of a Vercel Log Drain, which needs a paid Vercel plan.
